title: Constructible approximation for prime-torsion pullback cohomology
statement: Let a:Y → X be a morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, let r be prime, and suppose pullback is bijective in every nonnegative degree for every constructible sheaf of ULift(ZMod r)-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Then pullback is bijective in every degree for every abelian etale sheaf G [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with r times its identity zero. The comparison is the existing cohomologyMap [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. No curve, properness, reducedness or field-extension square is assumed.

proof.text: Use the canonical cyclic coefficient lift to obtain M and an underlying abelian sheaf isomorphism to G. Obtain the existing filtered constructible presentation of M.

Apply moduleSheaf_underlying_isColimit to the presentation. Cohomology on X and Y preserves these large filtered cocones by sheafH_isColimit_large_filtered; inverse image preservation is supplied by its existing left adjoint instance. Form the natural transformation whose components are cohomologyMap. The constructibility comparison supplies each Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf instance. H makes every component of the whiskered transformation an isomorphism. The categorical colimit lemma makes the component on the cocone vertex an isomorphism. Finally transport bijectivity across the two cohomology isomorphisms induced by the underlying sheaf isomorphism, using cohomologyMap_map.

proof_origin.place: 03SA(3) and 03Q5; U2 implements the naturality and isomorphism transport in Lean, with separate underlying-colimit and large-continuity bridges

lean.statement:
theorem bijective_cohomologyMap_of_constructible_prime
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ X)
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime]
    (H : ∀ (M : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))) [Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf M],
      ∀ q : ℕ, Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap a
        ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M) q))
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hG : r • 𝟙 G = 0) (q : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap a G q)
